scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted an application for a VA home purchase loan for $635,000 with a 30-year term. Could you please tell me the status or outcome of my application?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your inquiry. Your VA home purchase loan application for $635,000 with a 30-year term was approved and the loan has been finalized. Following origination, your loan was sold to Ginnie Mae. If you have any other questions about your loan details, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the update. That’s a relief to hear! Can you please tell me what my assigned interest rate is, and if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your assigned interest rate is 6.750%. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features. Let me know if you have any other questions about your loan.

dialogue.user: Thanks for the information. Could you also tell me what my total loan costs are, and what my debt-to-income ratio means for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your total loan costs are $3,164.50. The debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is a percentage that compares your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income used for the loan decision. However, your specific DTI ratio is not available in the loan record provided. If you need further details, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for clarifying the total costs and explaining the DTI ratio, even though the exact percentage isn’t available. I feel like all my main questions were answered clearly, and the information was straightforward. I’m satisfied with this experience.

<Satisfied> – The agent was polite, gave specific and easy-to-understand answers, and addressed each of my questions promptly. I appreciated the transparency about what information was and wasn’t available.
